title: Actual integral coefficient extension and its termwise triangulated comparison
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and norm induced from the embedding, and let $X$ be a scheme whose underlying topological space is Noetherian. Let $\varphi:\mathcal O_{E,X}\to E_X$ be the coefficient-ring morphism of [def-sfb-integers-to-subfield], let $T=\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi$ be extension on internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], and let $L=L(T)$ be its total left derived functor [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. Then $T$ is exact (additive and preserving finite limits and finite colimits), and $L$ is naturally isomorphic to the functor $D(T)$ induced by termwise application of $T$. In particular $L$ is additive and triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Under the actual continuous coefficient identifications of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], $\varphi$ is the continuous integral-to-field inclusion and $L$ is $\operatorname{integralScalarExtension}$. Write $\mathcal C=D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E)$ and $\mathcal D=D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},E)$ [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], with full inclusions $i,j$, and put $F=\operatorname{boundedConstructibleExtendScalars}(X,\ell,E)$ [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-extend-scalars]. The source $\mathcal C$ is triangulated with its inherited triangles, $F$ is additive, and the specified compatibility isomorphism $Fj\cong iL$ identifies the image of every distinguished triangle of $\mathcal C$ under $Fj$ with its distinguished image under the ambient triangulated functor $L$.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(2), preparatory exact scalar-extension and triangulated comparison, made precise for the blueprint internal module objects; live item proof step 1

proof.text: First identify the actual coefficient map, before using any exactness result. In the induced norm, the valuation ring in the statement is $\mathcal O_E=\{x\in E:\|x\|\leq1\}$, with the subspace topology. On a profinite test object $S$, the map of [def-sfb-integers-to-subfield-point] sends $f\in C(S,\mathcal O_E)$ to the same function with values in $E$. This is exactly postcomposition with the continuous inclusion used in [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Both maps on $X$ are obtained by applying the same inverse-image functor $p_X^*$, by [def-sfb-integers-to-subfield]. Thus they agree under the stipulated continuous coefficient identifications. By [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars], $L$ is the total left derived functor of extension along this very map; this is precisely the functor denoted $\operatorname{integralScalarExtension}$ in [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients].

source.place: Continuous inclusion on profinite tests; compare def-sfb-integers-to-subfield and Bhatt–Scholze §6.8

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-scalar-exact] to the continuous inclusion identified in step 1. Its hypotheses are a prime $\ell$, a normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra which is a field, and an arbitrary scheme; the present finite normed extension $E$ and $X$ satisfy them. Hence $T$ preserves finite limits. Independently, clause 2 of [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars] says that this extension functor preserves finite colimits. Apply [lem-sfb-preserving-colimits-additive] to the two abelian module categories to obtain additivity of $T$. These are exactly the three asserted parts of exactness.

source.place: §6.8, continuous integral localization; exactness supplied by the existing continuous-integral-scalar-exact node, and finite-colimit additivity by Stacks 010N (homology.tex, lemma-exact-functor)

proof.text:
By [def-sfb-left-derived-exact], exactness gives the canonical comparison $\alpha:L\xrightarrow{\sim}D(T)$, for the total left derived functor specified in the statement. Equivalently, if $P\to K$ is a K-flat resolution, this comparison is induced by the quasi-isomorphism $T(P)\to T(K)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], termwise $T$ induces an additive triangulated functor $D(T)$, with its shift comparison and factorization through localization. Give $L$ the transported shift comparison
$$c^L_K=(\alpha_K[1])^{-1}\circ c^{D(T)}_K\circ\alpha_{K[1]}.$$
Naturality of $\alpha$ identifies its images of the three arrows of each triangle, including the last arrow using this formula. The image triangle under $L$ is therefore isomorphic to its distinguished image under $D(T)$, so is distinguished. Also $\alpha_B\circ L(f+g)=D(T)(f+g)\circ\alpha_A=\alpha_B\circ(L(f)+L(g))$ for $f,g:A\to B$; cancellation proves additivity of $L$.

source.place: Tag 015F (lemma-right-derived-exact-functor), termwise exact functors; Tag 014X (lemma-additive-exact-homotopy-category); canonical left-derived comparison as in def-sfb-left-derived-exact

proof.text: The continuous integral coefficients identified in step 1 satisfy [lem-weil-pbc-integral-constructible-serre]: for finite normed $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and topologically Noetherian $X$, the stratified pro-étale locally finitely presented module objects are closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions. They contain zero and are invariant under isomorphism by their definition. Consequently [prop-weil-pbc-module-bounded-constructible-triangulated] applies to this class in the integral module category. Its full subcategory of bounded complexes with such cohomology is exactly $\mathcal C$ of [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], with no additional derived-completeness condition. Thus $\mathcal C$ has the inherited triangulated structure and its inclusion $i$ takes distinguished triangles to distinguished ambient triangles.

source.place: Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3), pp. 60–61; the existing integral-constructible-serre node supplies the internal-module formulation

proof.text: By [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-extend-scalars], the functor $F$ sends $K$ to $L(iK)$ with its constructibility witness, sends $u$ to $L(iu)$, and the specified isomorphism $\beta:Fj\xrightarrow{\sim}iL$ has identity components. Since the inclusions are full, addition of morphisms is ambient addition; hence $jF(u+v)=L(iu+iv)=L(iu)+L(iv)=j(Fu+Fv)$, and faithfulness of $j$ gives additivity of $F$. For a distinguished triangle $K\to K'\to K''\xrightarrow{w}K[1]$ in $\mathcal C$, step 4 makes its $i$-image distinguished, and step 3 makes its $L$-image distinguished. Use on $Fj$ the shift comparison transported from $iL$ along $\beta$. Naturality gives $\beta_{K'}\circ j(Fu)=L(iu)\circ\beta_K$ for each arrow $u$; the transported shift gives the same equation for the final arrow to $K[1]$. Thus $\beta$ is an isomorphism from the entire $Fj$-image triangle to this distinguished ambient image. This proves exactly the specified triangle compatibility in [def-weil-triangulated-category].

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q43-2aeebdfe5 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read all five steps and every cited statement in full. This is the item's first split: it is unsplit and proof-free in live and side-live, has no repair note, and is not on the dropped list. There are no new nodes, the statement is unchanged, nothing cites SGA, and there is no cycle (closure of 682 nodes, containing neither the item nor its parent). Source: Bhatt–Scholze Prop. 6.8.14(2), pp. 61–62, and the first paragraph of the main-20261015 blueprint proof of thm-sfb-extend-scalars-localization ('F is induced by an exact functor, so it is triangulated'). The Lean target is EllAdicRationalization.lean lines 109–141, where the compatibility isomorphism has identity components; this matches def-sfb-bounded-constructible-extend-scalars. Step 1: both coefficient maps are postcomposition with the inclusion of the closed unit ball (C(S,O_E) to C(S,E)), followed by the same pullback along p_X; Lean's integralScalarExtension has the same shape, and the step is genuinely elementary. Step 2: finite limits come from the pbc exactness lemma (Lean integralScalarExtension_exact), whose hypotheses hold for E in Q̄_ℓ with the induced norm. Finite colimits come from clause 2 of sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars, and additivity from the preserving-colimits node. Abelianness of the module categories comes from clause 4 of that same cited node but is not named in the step (advisory). Step 3: I checked the types of the transported shift c^L = (α_K[1])⁻¹∘c^{D(T)}∘α_{K[1]}, and that α is an isomorphism of triangles including the last arrow. Distinguishedness then follows from the axiom that triangles isomorphic to distinguished ones are distinguished, and additivity by cancelling α. The statement does not fix a shift structure on L, so transporting one is legitimate. Step 4: the integral Serre-closure lemma (finite E, Noetherian space; Lean integralConstructible_serre) is about the same lfp constructible predicate as the sfb definition (both are ProEtale.BoundedConstructible). On a Noetherian space every locally closed stratum is constructible. Citing the pbc triangulated proposition repeats the last paragraph of sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible but is harmless. No derived completeness enters. Step 5: identity components and full faithfulness give additivity. With the shift transported along β, β is an isomorphism from each Fj-image triangle onto the distinguished L∘i-image triangle, which is exactly the statement's clause. Edge cases (X empty, E = Q_ℓ, the zero complex) are fine. I found no duplicates among the integralScalarExtension and integers-to-subfield citers. I accept the three tool_uses: pbc continuous-integral-scalar-exact, integral-constructible-serre and module-bounded-constructible-triangulated. The unit's own route would use det-prop flatness, but the pbc lemma is the exact assertion about the item's own integralScalarExtension and its closure is clean. Maintainer note: the proof totals 4287 characters, so a later re-split note for proofs over 3000 characters could re-release it.
